title: features with the owner's slice and value (.brick-harness/features.json)
description: Slice and value are the owner's data, each with a cited source, never an agent's estimate. A feature without slice, value or a resolving source ranks last and is listed as unvalued. bhcore.value_queue orders the work from these.

slice.description: 1 = the smallest sellable end-to-end product; each next slice the next most valuable increment.

value.description: The owner's value of the feature (any unit; compared only between features).

acceptance.description: Id of the system item that measures the feature end to end.

source.description: file:line (checked) or tracker ref of the owner's statement of slice and value.
